meta.title: Recreate with Event End Time Duration 15 Mins

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary without creating or searching for another event.
Open the stage Settings action that launches the Recreate Order dialog.
Confirm the Recreate Order dialog contains the Product Sheet option.
Confirm the dialog contains Auction Configurations.
Confirm the dialog contains Delivery Date.
Confirm the dialog contains the scheduling choice.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order dialog, select Event End Time Duration 15 Mins, keep Evaluation Duration at 30 Mins, leave scheduling disabled or unscheduled, click Create Order, and verify the newly created event opens live with a new RFX or stage code, the same product, quantity, location and participants, and Bidding Ends At 15 minutes after its start while the original event remains unchanged

steps.note: Perform and verify the recreate configuration and resulting live event because no catalog step can operate this dialog or compare all copied-event details.
Assert the browser is on the newly created event page after recreation.
Confirm the new event page exposes the expected bidding end-time information.
